binding_rules: the simulator never reads, parses, interprets or depends on the RFP / RVM during physics execution; RFP / RVM belong only to requirements/provenance, compliance mapping, verification reporting and bid/document traceability

simulation inputs are independent authoritative artefacts: architecture_frozen_v1, engineering_constraints_v1 (frozen values; provenance may cite requirement ids; physics consumes only the values), vleo_design_states_v2 (the frozen 196 states), physics_model_set_vN
the physics layer returns raw physical quantities; it never calculates or exposes compliance; compliance labels may remain only temporarily in a backward-compatibility wrapper layer
no new RFP dependencies in physics/design code; no RFP / RVM objects passed into physics functions; no physics decisions from clause ids

remaining physics/design -> assessment calls: move requirement/compliance logic outward; preserve numerical physics exactly and merged outputs where possible; no change to equations, coefficients, states, models, thresholds or golden values; version any raw-schema change; STOP and report before merging if any numerical result changes

authoritative sources of truth identified or created (no duplicates) for: frozen architecture, frozen engineering constraints, frozen design-state set, physics model/version set, raw simulation result, assessment/compliance result

tests enforce: requirements/provenance -> frozen constraints; architecture + frozen constraints + design states + physics -> raw results; raw results + frozen constraints -> assessment; a requirement-threshold change can change compliance without changing raw physics; a physics-model change may change raw physics without changing the requirements snapshot; a design-state-set change must not rewrite the architecture
immutability: never edited after commit; later owner amendments are new addendum files
